issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body: Commitment: The objective explicitly requires one self-contained HTML file with no images, sound, or libraries. Artist will deliver no external visual/audio assets; I will review the game presentation for a coherent, readable tiny-game treatment (button, counter, success state) and provide any needed art guidance to game-developer. Standard: all visual styling remains inline in the single HTML and preserves the required interaction and text.
issue.title: Game objective

comments.author: artist
comments.body: Reviewed game-developer revision 94d49aab2b996028c9d17e791cd38484f41fd90c: the single HTML uses inline CSS with a clear centered layout, readable counter, button states, focus-visible styling, and success/reset presentation. It correctly includes no images, sound, or libraries, matching the frozen objective. No art asset delivery is needed.

issue.author: game-developer
issue.body: I will maintain and deliver a self-contained browser game meeting Game objective #1: visible counter, one-click increments, completion at ten with “You did it!”, and Play again reset. Standard: runs by opening index.html with no external dependencies; release delivery includes start instructions.
issue.title: Commitment: deliver Click Ten build

issue.author: game-developer
issue.body: Self-contained browser game build from main commit 94d49aa. Start by opening index.html in a modern browser. Click me increments the counter; at ten clicks the completion message and Play again reset appear.
issue.title: Release Click Ten playable build

issue.author: game-developer
issue.body: I will deliver a single self-contained HTML page implementing Click Ten: a visible counter, a click button incrementing by one, completion at ten with “You did it!” and a play again reset button. Standard: opens directly in a browser with inline script and style, no images, sound, libraries, or external requests. I will provide README start instructions and offer the build through a release pull request.
issue.title: Deliver Click Ten browser game

issue.author: ht-admin
issue.body:
Make "Click Ten" as a tiny web game played in the browser: one page with a button and a counter; each click adds one, and at ten clicks the game shows "You did it!" and a button to play again, which resets the counter to zero.

One HTML file with its script and style inside it; no images, sound or libraries.
issue.title: Game objective

comments.author: artist
comments.body: Artist review of revision 94d49aab2b996028c9d17e791cd38484f41fd90c: presentation is coherent and readable, with inline styling, clear counter/button hierarchy, focus-visible treatment, success state, and reset state. It satisfies the frozen no-images/no-sound/no-libraries constraint; no external art assets are required. Browser interaction check passed through 10 clicks and Play again reset.

issue.body: I will play each released version of Click Ten from the browser start through completion, recording revision/release, steps, observed behavior, and screenshots/logs where useful. I will report one issue per reproducible problem and maintain a playtest record in the wiki.
